notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Kami of Whispered Hopes does not have summoning sickness and has a power of at least two.
Freed from the Real attached to Attentive Sunscribe.
description:
Activate Kami of Whispered Hopes by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Repeat.
Activate Freed from the Real's first ability by paying {U}, tapping Attentive Sunscribe.
Attentive Sunscribe triggers, causing you to scry 1.
Arwen Undómiel triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Attentive Sunscribe.
Repeat.
